## Outline

- Image classification with UAS data: pixel based, object based, and scene classification
- Spectral information: reflectance, sensor bands, calibration, and vegetation indices from RGB and multispectral imagery
- Features for classification: spatial filters, texture, and terrain derivatives from the DSM
- Segmentation: superpixels, object statistics, and promptable foundation models (SAM 2)
- Training and prediction: supervised and unsupervised methods, sampling design, random forests, and feature importance
- Accuracy assessment: the confusion matrix, user's and producer's accuracy, kappa, and held-out reference data

## Supplemental materials

- [Random Forests](https://doi.org/10.1023/A:1010933404324), Breiman, Machine Learning 45(1), 2001
- [A review of assessing the accuracy of classifications of remotely sensed data](https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(91)90048-B), Congalton, Remote Sensing of Environment 37(1), 1991
- [Textural Features for Image Classification](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSMC.1973.4309314), Haralick, Shanmugam, and Dinstein, IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics SMC-3(6), 1973
- [samgeo: A Python package for segmenting geospatial data with the Segment Anything Model (SAM)](https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.05663), Wu and Osco, Journal of Open Source Software 8(89), 2023
- [r.learn.ml2](https://grass.osgeo.org/grass85/manuals/addons/r.learn.ml2.html), [r.texture](https://grass.osgeo.org/grass85/manuals/r.texture.html), [i.vi](https://grass.osgeo.org/grass85/manuals/i.vi.html), and [i.sam2](https://grass.osgeo.org/grass85/manuals/addons/i.sam2.html) manual pages
- [UAS for Wetland Mapping and Hydrological Modeling](https://doi.org/10.3390/rs11171997), Jeziorska, Remote Sensing 11(17), 2019: a review of UAS sensors, including the multispectral cameras compared in the lecture
- [Absolute Radiometric Calibration Evaluation of UAS Headwall and MicaSense Sensors](https://doi.org/10.3390/rs17223738), Shrestha et al., Remote Sensing 17(22), 2025: the USGS calibration campaign whose data the lab uses
- [Guidelines for calibration of uncrewed aircraft systems imagery](https://pubs.usgs.gov/publication/ofr20231033/full), Sampath et al., USGS Open-File Report 2023-1033
- [Rapid-DEM: Rapid Topographic Updates through Satellite Change Detection and UAS Data Fusion](https://doi.org/10.3390/rs14071718), White et al., Remote Sensing 14(7), 2022
- Introductory Digital Image Processing: A Remote Sensing Perspective, 4th ed., Jensen, Pearson, 2015
